title: Mindfulness-based interventions and cognitive function among breast cancer survivors: a systematic review
authors: Cifu G, Power MC, Shomber S, Arem H
notes: Systematic review of 4 mindfulness-based intervention studies for cognitive outcomes in breast cancer survivors. Constituent studies should be queued for DEEP extraction via hop discovery.
